worldcombat.skill.revivalblessing.summar: Responds to a nearby ally’s fall and restores half the maximum health of one fainted Pokémon in the user’s party. The revived ally remains in reserve.
worldcombat.skill.revivalblessing.use.0: Pray after an ally falls to bring a fainted party member back to half HP
worldcombat.skill.revivalblessing.use.1: Grant the loving blessing to living allies nearby
worldcombat.skill.revivalblessing.use.2: Mark the place of a fall with one prayer
worldcombat.skill.revivalblessing.descri: Requires an allied creature to have fallen within %1$s blocks in the last 80 seconds. It restores %2$s of maximum health to a fainted Pokémon in the user’s party, preferring the fallen creature’s species and otherwise another fainted member. A wild user or a party with no fainted member produces only the light pillar.
Nearby allies display a blessing icon to mark the prayer; only the revived party member receives healing.
Vigil: prayer range ×1.25, four extra wind-up ticks and forty extra cooldown ticks.
Brief prayer: range ×0.85, with a shorter wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.revivalblessing.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.revivalblessing.growth: From level %1$s the prayer reaches %2$s blocks.
From level %1$s the prayer reaches %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.revivalblessing.prefer: Enabled: range ×1.25, four extra wind-up ticks and forty extra cooldown ticks. Disabled: range ×0.85 and faster execution.
On: only prays over a fallen ally while facing a threat. Off (default): answers a fallen ally even out of combat.
